claims.reason: The table in line 10 shows Intel's contribution margin for 2021A-2028E, with actuals of 55.4% (2021A), 42.6% (2022A), and 40.0% (2023A). These are relatively high margins, supporting the qualitative claim of 'robust' contribution margins.
